hint.en: Draw an oval for the head, a box for the body and a wide oval for the skirt. Add two slanted lines for the legs.
Sketch the two raised arms with a circle for each paw, a small curve for the tail and a triangle for each ear. Add a centre line and eye line on the head.
Trace the rounded head and the two pointed ears, then add the small mark inside each ear.
Draw the closed happy eyes, tiny nose, smiling mouth and three whiskers on each side.

title.en: Ink the arms, body and legs

hint.en: Outline the raised arms with their paw marks, the body, the tail and the two legs with little toe lines.
Draw the wavy puffy skirt over the waist, then add the two music notes floating beside the cat.

colorHint.en: White cat with soft pink cheeks, a pink skirt with white polka dots and a light green background.
